Name: MissCoriel's SVE Music Pack
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
SVE is pretty popular.  It is only fitting that it gets the Music Treatment!  7 songs just for SVE are in this pack, all handcrafted by me.  

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Listen to the Music Pack here![/size][/color]
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/expanded-music-pack[/soundcloud]


Installation:

Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿

Don't forget to Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿

Put this mod in your mods folder.
